title: Aayla Secura
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: Aayla Secura, a blue-skinned Twi-lek, was a cunning Jedi warrior who fought during the Clone Wars and into the final hours of the Jedi Order. She was leading a contingent of clone troops on the lush world of Felucia when Darth Sidious called upon the clones to execute Order 66. They killed her without remorse and with no regard for her record of helping the galaxy as a Jedi.
